question: Describe the connection between a ruler divided into tenths and decimal notation.
answer: Each tenth is one of ten equal parts of a unit. Thus 1/10 is 0.1, 2/10 is 0.2, and so on; mixed measures such as 3 4/10 can be represented as 3.4.
